_comment: Copy to aethron_admin_config.json (gitignored) and fill in. Env vars override every key. NEVER commit the real file — it holds the service_role key and Netlify token, which grant full access.
_admin_emails: Comma-separated. ONLY these accounts can sign into the admin, even with a valid Aethron login. Everyone else is refused.
_supabase_note: Bypasses row-level security so the Operations tab can list all users and change plans. Server-side ONLY — never shipped, never in a browser. Supabase URL + anon key are read from aethron_config.json / env.
netlify_token: nfp_...  (Netlify → User settings → Applications → Personal access tokens)
netlify_site_id: incandescent-longma-2957f0  (Netlify → Site configuration → Site ID / API ID)
